The Planner failed to validate the host's identity against the "British singer-songwriter" criteria and prematurely marked Ed Sheeran as the answer without reconciling the contradiction that Kelly Osbourne, a British television personality and not a singer-songwriter, was explicitly listed as the host. This demonstrates a failure in source synthesis and verification.**
